name: canary
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the Canary Claude Code plugin (Interactive Brokers portfolio analysis and trading research).

plugins.name: canary
plugins.description: Canary's local Interactive Brokers risk desk: daily brief, account and positions, named-symbol technical evidence, rulebook, protection proposals, option-exercise opportunities, and order-lifecycle reads. The 13 MCP tools are read-only; constrained CLI broker actions remain gated by local trading status, fresh confirmation or preflight, and daemon policy. Requires the `canary` binary on PATH; see the project README for install and update instructions.
